# Official scorer execution extension - w-offscorer2

This packet narrows clause S4 of `scorer-offline-closure`; it closes no shared or
dataset blocker and grants no production or pilot authorization. The report is
`reports/w-offscorer2-coverage.md`. Per-input raw returns, complete exceptions,
controlled inputs and commands live in the component directories. Counts describe
scorer controls, never benchmark accuracy or a model run.

Independent upstream calls and unchanged local scorers receive the same controlled
input bytes. Complete imports, selected unchanged upstream AST functions, native
engine execution and workflow preprocessing differences are reported separately.
Installed-package identities do not by themselves authenticate a published build.
Prior pinned archives and provenance responses are reused read-only and rehashed;
there is no new network acquisition.

The controls use strict kernel socket denial, explicit local UNIX IPC where required,
or a new network namespace containing only loopback for local JVM/LibreOffice IPC.
The individual receipts establish which profile actually ran. These are fixture
observations and do not establish production verifier custody, complete dependency
or ABI closure, state-export equivalence or live pilot admission.

`reasoning_gym/` uses wholly authored entries and predictions. `bird_ds/` uses
authored SQLite worlds and code contexts. `spreadsheetbench/` uses authored workbooks;
the release mirror is checked for byte identity only. `worlds/` labels real study
worlds and distinguishes authored action traces from any reference-derived control.
Released heldout tasks, models, GPUs and endpoints are outside these controls.

The root `SHA256SUMS` covers every packet file except itself and Python bytecode,
including nested manifests and raw failure observations. After intentional changes:

```sh
python3 tests/fixtures/hg_woffscorer2/refresh_manifest.py
python3 tests/fixtures/hg_woffscorer2/verify.py
python3 tools/check_dataset_blockers.py
```

`verify.py` also checks that the registry change is limited to the shared blocker's
appended observations/evidence, dataset records and next actions stay unchanged,
the journal is append-only, and production source bytes match baseline `9dab533`.
The component validators check their raw joins and guard observations independently.
Final commands and outputs are preserved in `reports/w-offscorer2-validation.txt`.
